Previous experience as an administrative assistant, ideally in a fast-paced or academic/healthcare environment.
Prior experience working within higher education or an academic medical center (such as the UC system).
Provide comprehensive administrative support to assigned faculty members, managing complex calendars and scheduling.
Coordinate all travel arrangements, itineraries, and associated administrative logistics for faculty.
Serve as a primary administrative liaison for internal and external professional activities across UCI, UC Irvine Health, the School of Medicine, and national/international partners.
Screen incoming inquiries, answer phone calls, prioritize requests, and draft polished business correspondence using proper English and grammar.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, specifically Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Proven track record of managing confidential and sensitive issues.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively with a diverse range of individuals daily.
Advanced skill in coordinating complex domestic and international travel arrangements.
Demonstrated ability to multi-task, prioritize workload, and apply sound judgment in a constantly changing environment.
Strong organizational skills with a history of independently managing multiple competing priorities.
